name: pulumi
description: Pointer-only preset for the Pulumi Infrastructure-as-Code framework. Surfaces the canonical Pulumi skill suite (`pulumi/agent-skills`, Apache-2.0) at install time on projects containing a `Pulumi.yaml` config — authoritative Pulumi authoring patterns + migration workflows (Terraform→Pulumi, CloudFormation→Pulumi). No foundation skill filter, no marketplace plugin, no defaults override. Pulumi is independent (no vendor-neutrality concern). See `docs/recipes/recommended-vendor-skills.md` §Pulumi and `specs/presets-vendor-pointer-tier/spec.md` for the tier semantics.

recommendedVendorSkills.rationale: Canonical Pulumi authoring patterns + migration workflows (Terraform→Pulumi, CloudFormation→Pulumi). Verified via `gh api repos/pulumi/agent-skills` on 2026-05-18 — 48★, last commit 2026-05-13, Apache-2.0, not archived. Pair with claude-base's `ops-infra-code` skill (module hierarchy, naming conventions, deploy workflow).

outOfScope: Foundation skill curation — no `foundation.skills.keep/drop` filter (vendor-pointer tier)
Opinionated install-time defaults — inherited from foundation defaults
Terraform projects — see the `antonbabenko/terraform-skill` recipe entry instead
CloudFormation / CDK / Bicep / generic IaC tooling — out of this preset's scope
